slides.headline: "HOW MUCH MONEY DO I NEED?"
slides.sub: The question we are asked most.
slides.note: There is no single number. The answer changes with your destination and the length of your trip.

slides.answer: IT IS A CALCULATION, NOT A THRESHOLD.
slides.body: Your destination's daily requirement, multiplied by the number of days you will be there. That is the target.
slides.note: Which is why a calculator is more useful than an article.

slides.headline: THE ADVICE THAT COSTS PEOPLE APPROVALS
slides.never: Move a large sum into the account days before applying. The officer reads the whole statement, not one line. A sudden balance with no history reads as borrowed money and works against you.
slides.instead: Show a balance held steadily over months, with a clear and traceable source. The decision rests on financial history, not on the figure the day you apply.

slides.headline: LEVERS ACTUALLY EXIST
items: Shorten the trip — fewer days, lower requirement
Add a sponsor, declared properly with evidence
Start earlier so the history has time to settle
